notes.title: New Lonesome Village v1.2 update with more languages and cloud save!
notes.notes:
New Lonesome Village v1.2 update with more languages, cloud save and more!

We are happy to share that we have a new version 1.2 for Lonesome Village!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711530/d883df2d19804092bc9e8790440af2c3913c3f76.png

This one has the following new languages:

 Korean
 Simplified Chinese

This new version also includes cloud save support!

And last but not least, this one also has big improvements in performance and bug fixes!

Thanks again for all the support received, we hope you are enjoying the game!

If you like our game please consider leaving a review, that helps a lot!

Steve
Ogre Pixel
www.ogrepixel.com

notes.title: Lonesome Village v1.1 new update!
notes.notes:
Release of Version 1.1 of Lonesome Village on Steam

We are excited to announce that Version 1.1 of Lonesome Village is now available on Steam.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711530/cca90c96767c4519d054d65edd47ca10840b2252.png

This update includes significant improvements:


 Optimized cinematic playback on Steam Deck
 Enhancements to the windmill's functionality
 Other bug fixes.


A Tiny Sticker Tale Launch Next Week!

We also want to share that we have a new game coming next week titled A Tiny Sticker Tale

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711530/67c785cfbd86fef8b24744fb07f786fd5ad0513c.png

It will be launched this October 4th with 10% discount! You can check the Steam page here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2322180/A_Tiny_Sticker_Tale/


Steve
Ogre Pixel
www.ogrepixel.com

notes.title: New Lonesome Village v1.0.1.8 now Live with bug fixes!
notes.notes:
We are so happy to share that the new Lonesome Village v1.0.1.8 has arrived with bug fixes:


 Vault blocker fixed
 Mouse puzzle with cheese pieces bug fixed
 The last book on Hanzo the Turtle house bug fixed
 Crafting UI bug fixed
 Journal achievements now working properly
 And many more bugs were fixed!


If you are enjoying Lonesome Village please consider rating it! 😀

Ogre Pixel
2022
